2026-09-29 VERBATIM TEXT:
"The D&B Finance Analytics data store is available in Public Preview in Gemini Enterprise.
You can connect D&B Finance Analytics to look up company and credit reports, scores, filings,
and corporate ownership, and to search and compare the companies in your portfolios, using
natural language. The data store also supports actions, such as creating and processing
credit applications and managing folders."

Regions: not stated in the release note.
DOC GAP: no per-store page exists for either D&B store. The shared overview at
/gemini/enterprise/docs/connectors/d-and-b-commercial-graph does NOT enumerate actions,
auth model, or entity types. Follow-up sweep owed.

CONNECTOR-ACTION EXPANSION PATTERN: 6 scans — 8/21, 8/30, 9/02, 9/18, 9/22, 9/24.
Every new Gemini Enterprise data store now ships with write actions by default.
